description: Punctuality for an SBB stop on the previous operating day (ist-daten-sbb target vs actual times). Returns stop counts, arrival and departure delay counts, cancellations, and a short sample of delayed arrivals. A stop is delayed when SBB flags it, which is generally a delay of about three minutes or more.

contains.description: When true, match station names that contain the text. Default false matches the whole name.

line.description: Optional line filter (e.g. IC1, IR15, S7).

station.description: Station name as published by SBB (e.g. Bern, Zürich HB, Genève).

name: get_station_punctuality
